findings: `summary.text` overstates the graphic sequence by saying later forms add a horizontal stroke without qualification. Revise to say descriptions report a central dot in some mid-Western Zhou bronze forms, later extended into a short horizontal stroke; the seal-style cross is a transmitted Shuowen form, not proof of a precise sequence. Cite `X-c73ef365483ffa93a664`, `X-dbcdf7ac6352539aa126`, and `X-ea6d6eef7d9adcbb2c78`.

`learner.overview.text` says the familiar cross follows the early single stroke as a direct, settled development. Qualify the change: descriptions report a central dot in some forms that later extended into a short horizontal stroke, while the cross is also attested in the Shuowen tradition. Cite `X-c73ef365483ffa93a664`, `X-dbcdf7ac6352539aa126`, and `X-ea6d6eef7d9adcbb2c78`.
